$comment: Skip budget for `vitest run`, enforced by scripts/check_skip_budget.mjs. Each entry names a test file and how many of its tests may skip in each environment: `local` (a developer machine that holds the gitignored capture data and an xpdf pdftotext) and `ci` (a clean checkout on ubuntu-latest with Postgres, Chromium and poppler-utils). A skipped test in a file not listed here, or above its count, fails the check. Lower a number when a skip is fixed. Raise one only with a reason written here.

tests/eventFirstImport.test.ts.reason: describe.skipIf(!HAVE_CAPTURE). Needs data/swimcloud-captures (gitignored) AND every stored page of meet 356467 to still match the sha256 its capture recorded. Absent in CI. Locally the pages have drifted, because a later team crawl overwrote the one file the page store keeps per URL.

tests/relayLegCreditsPersistence.test.ts.reason: describe.skipIf(!pgUrl). The PostgreSQL round trip needs PG_TEST_URL or DATABASE_URL. CI sets PG_TEST_URL on the Test step and the postgres:16 service; a developer machine usually has no database.

tests/divingEventImport.test.ts.reason: describe.skipIf(no stored diving pages). Reads data/swimcloud-captures/pages, which is gitignored (local-only by design, plans/2026-09-06/01-legal-and-access-strategy.md section 4).

tests/meetEventIndex.test.ts.reason: describe.skipIf(no stored event pages). Reads data/swimcloud-captures/pages (gitignored).

tests/relayLegsHiddenList.test.ts.reason: describe.skipIf(no stored relay page). Reads data/swimcloud-captures/pages (gitignored).

tests/swimCloudMeetImportBridge.test.ts.reason: describe.skipIf(no stored event 8 page), the 'event 8 exhibition flags' block. Reads data/swimcloud-captures/pages (gitignored). The other 50 tests in the file use committed fixtures and still run.

tests/theoreticalMeetGolden.test.ts.reason: describe.skipIf(!realPresent), the 'ALL the real captures' block. Reads data/swimcloud-captures/captures (gitignored).

tests/workspaceScopePg.test.ts.reason: describe.skipIf(!pgUrl). Cross-tenant scope, duplicate id, version conflict, global-replace ownership and the newer-schema refusal need a real PostgreSQL server (PG_TEST_URL or DATABASE_URL). CI sets PG_TEST_URL on the postgres:16 service; a developer machine usually has no database.

tests/rosterOnlyRankCollapse.test.ts.reason: describe.skipIf(no data/meets.json), the 'D8 on the real HSU 2026-27 Roster Plan' block. Reads the live private workspace store (gitignored). The constructed 214-recruit and 67-plan cases in the same file use no local data and still run.

tests/conferenceRelayPrograms.test.ts.reason: it.skipIf(no local results PDF and text). data/relay-programs/sources/*.pdf and *.txt are gitignored because they name every athlete at the GLVC meet (public repo, decision U8). The manifest and the data file are tracked.
